Prioritised the segment backlog collaboratively with two feature teams using the team’s weighted prioritisation method, maintaining scoring sheets and quarterly roadmap reviews in the product folder (src_47866b04d9cc).
Reported segment adoption to the product director each quarter, clearly distinguishing personal metrics from analytics team data (src_fadb60c6c75d).
Authored the roadmap boundary note and hand‑over conditions for the segment on a quarterly basis (src_70378720ddfe).
Presented the segment roadmap to individual customers during discovery calls and to the sales team at quarterly sales kick‑off events (src_30099e02616d).
